posts.title: Introducing the 5GMAGazine
posts.excerpt: 5G-MAG has launched the 5GMAGazine, a new publication bringing specification analysis, software releases and community news to one place, starting with [Issue 01](/magazine).

posts.title: 5G-MAG Showcases 3GPP Release 18 MBS at ESA's NTN Forum
posts.excerpt: 5G-MAG took center stage at the European Space Agency's (ESA) NTN Forum Colloquium & General Assembly, bringing an end-to-end demonstration of its open-source 3GPP Release 18 [5G Multicast Broadcast Services (MBS)](/reference-tools/5g-mbs) reference tools.

posts.title: 5G-MAG at MPEG/ITU Workshop: driving open-source development for faster technology deployment
posts.excerpt: The ITU-T SG21 and ISO/IEC JTC 1/SC 29 (MPEG) joint workshop on "Media Streaming Services – What's next," held in Geneva, brought together industry leaders to discuss the future of media streaming and the challenges of technology deployment. 5G-MAG took part to make the case for a closer relationship between standards development and open-source software, to help shorten the path from written specification to real-world market adoption.

posts.title: 5G-MAG at MWC Shanghai: Towards Media-Aware Intelligent Networks
posts.excerpt: At MWC Shanghai (24–26 June, SNIEC), 5G-MAG showcased the live demonstration "Towards Media-Aware Intelligent Networks — Smarter Video Streaming for 6G" at Qualcomm's booth.

posts.title: First 5G Broadcast PlugFest by 5G-MAG brings developers together in Berlin
posts.excerpt: The first 5G Broadcast PlugFest organized by 5G-MAG took place from 9 to 11 June 2026 at Fraunhofer FOKUS in Berlin, bringing together infrastructure vendors, technology providers, software developers and operators to test the interoperability of 5G Broadcast equipment.

posts.title: phine.tech - New 5G-MAG member
posts.excerpt: The 5G-MAG Steering Group has approved phine.tech as a new member of the association.

posts.title: Nokia - New official contributor to the 5G-MAG Reference Tools
posts.excerpt: Nokia has joined the 5G-MAG Reference Tools developer community as an official contributor.

posts.title: 5G-MAG elects Dolby's Frédéric Gabin as new Chair
posts.excerpt: 5G-MAG has elected Frédéric Gabin, Director of Mobile Technology & Standards at Dolby Laboratories, to chair its Steering Group, succeeding founding chair Antonio Arcidiacono (EBU), who is retiring after leading the association since its inception in 2019.

posts.title: 5G-MAG Elects New WG Chairs to Drive Standards and Software for Connected Media
posts.excerpt: 5G-MAG -- The Media Connectivity Association -- is pleased to announce the election of new chairs for its Working Groups, reinforcing its commitment to advancing media and connectivity technologies through open standards and collaborative development.

posts.title: 5G-MAG announces Steering Group leaders for the 2025-2027 term
posts.excerpt: The 5G-MAG General Assembly has elected its new Steering Group to lead the association's activities over the next two years.
